summary: T Stamp Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its deferred 2025 Annual Meeting held July 7, 2026. Stockholders voted to elect Class III directors, ratify CBIZ CPAs as auditor, and approve issuance of common stock purchase warrants (Series A for 370,370 shares and Series B for 277,778 shares, both at $8.10 per share) under a Securities Purchase Agreement with Armistice Capital Master Fund Ltd. per Nasdaq rules. No special situation transaction is present; this is a routine current report on an annual meeting outcome with ordinary shareholder proposals.
